Reads a GTFS feed (zip) into the project: Ifunda okuphakelwayo kwe-GTFS (zip) kuphrojekthi njengenethiwekhi ekhona yosuku olulodwa lwesevisi, enqunywe ekubukeni kwemephu uma kucelwe, ukuze umhleli wohambo ayisebenzise kanye nemigqa ehleliwe; futhi ibhala imigqa yephrojekthi njengokuphakelwayo kwe-GTFS kwamanye amathuluzi.
Stops, routes and the trips of one servi: Izitobhi, imizila nohambo losuku olulodwa lwesevisi (uLwesithathu olumatasa kakhulu ngaphandle uma kunikezwe usuku), ne-frequencies.txt njengamaphethini emvamisa nezinhlobo zemizila njengezinhlobo zokuthutha.
The project's lines as a weekday GTFS fe: Imigqa yephrojekthi njengokuphakelwayo kwe-GTFS kosuku lokusebenza: uhambo oluqondile, imigqa yemvamisa njenge-frequencies.txt, iziteshi zamaqembu ezitobhi.
